code:
# Microsoft Tay chatbot, 2016
#  - designed to learn conversational patterns
#    from live Twitter interactions
#  - coordinated users fed it offensive input
#  - Tay began reproducing it within ~16 hours
#  - taken offline the same day
#
# the failure: an unvalidated feedback channel,
# not anything specific to chatbots
caption: Any system that learns from unvalidated live input carries this same risk.
